column1: # B888-CC3 (#204): B step -- Enter from Explore mode: which character enters.
# No zone row: Testchar's last zone (Greater Faydark, per the select-screen
# caption CC-2 measured) is where Enter from Explore takes it -- the question
# is WHO enters, which the world log and the pcap's OP_EnterWorld answer.
# Testchar is ALREADY the login-selected row (the driver's login leaves the
# select screen with Testchar selected), so a bare Enter-press in Explore
# must enter with Testchar. Camp (Exit) is the clean in-world exit
# (wine-oracle.md); the driver's cleanup stops the world, which writes the
# zone-in back before the DB restore.
